description: This file contains shell script code for testing git hook behavior and ref handling in a git project. It includes setup commands, hook configuration, and a series of tests verifying handling of multiple ref rewrites, push operations, and remote references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a shell command, verifies output against expectations.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes and formats expected output, saves for comparison.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Transforms command output into a consistent, comparable format.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares references in the repository with expected refs.
